description: The plot illustrates the relationship between BLEU scores and the length of a gold prefix for two conditions: "Consistency: wait-1" and "Inconsistency: wait-9". The x-axis is labeled "the length of gold prefix" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "BLEU" and uses a linear scale ranging from 23 to 29, with tick marks at intervals of 1, accompanied by horizontal dashed grid lines. The line representing "Consistency: wait-1" is depicted with a blue dashed line and open circle markers. It begins at an x-value of 0 with a BLEU score of approximately 24.6, experiences an initial drop to a minimum of roughly 23.7 at x=1, and then exhibits a general upward trend across the remainder of the x-axis. It crosses a score of 25 near x=5, reaches approximately 26 at x=10, and concludes at its highest point of approximately 28.1 at x=20. The line representing "Inconsistency: wait-9" is shown as a solid orange line with solid red square markers. It starts at x=0 with a value of approximately 25.1, rises to a peak of roughly 26.1 at x=6, and then fluctuates downwards to a local minimum of about 25.3 at x=10. The line continues to fluctuate slightly, reaching its lowest point of approximately 25.1 at x=14 and x=15, before ending with an increase to approximately 25.9 at x=20.
